Seattle smoked salmon dip.note: We ship it anywhere, even Baltimore.

Radio show popcorn.note: Radio on till the call-in show signs off.

Annie's dinner with Walter.note: Mild and gentle. Nothing to sneeze at.

Valentine's heart cookies.d: Sugar cookies cut by hand, iced red and white.
